about: UCG Infinity (Open Scoring Level) scoring rules: digest of levels.md. Own words. 'cite' is the section of the UCG Infinity Rules v1.2 (source of record: the UCG Google Doc, see README). The same values and condensed groups are in skill_catalog/levels.json (WAG.infinity); the planner generates its Infinity tables (js/data/infinity-rules.js) from this file and levels.json.

condensed_eg_bonus.groups_in: skill_catalog/levels.json WAG.infinity.eg.condensed (USAG element group numbers; checked against the Infinity Rules Appendix table 2026-10-20)

group_names.about: the USAG element group names per event, as the planner shows them (labels only: short forms of the names in the IR Appendix table)

event_bonus.BB: acro series of 2 connected flight elements
event_bonus.FX: acro pass with at least 2 connected saltos (direct or indirect)

labels.BB: Acro series with 2 connected flight elements on beam
labels.FX: Acro pass with min. of 2 connected saltos (direct or indirect)
